invariants.rationale: The method returns a list constructed through streams and collects, and filters out nulls, so the result itself is never null.
The stream's filter(Objects::nonNull) ensures that all elements in result are non-null.
Each output record comes from merging one or more input records, so the output cannot have more records than the input.
Every result record is derived from input records and not invented, so all output records reference original input records.
Parallelism is typically required to be at least 1 (not static but implied by context for downstream operations).
